How often should ducts be cleaned here

In a coastal area like La Jolla Village, we usually suggest a duct cleaning every 3 to 5 years for most homes, and more often if you have shedding pets, a recent remodel, or allergies. Commercial spaces that bring in lots of foot traffic or have kitchen exhaust nearby may need cleaning more often. If you are managing a condo building with long common duct runs, plan regular checks and spot cleanings to keep air moving well.

We address these issues with the right tools, coatings, and maintenance schedules. That keeps the system reliable through foggy mornings and warm summer afternoons.

Seasonal tips for La Jolla Village

  • Spring pollen from nearby canyons can clog filters fast. Check filters monthly and upgrade to a higher MERV if your system supports it
  • Summer beach days mean extra laundry. Clean dryer vents yearly to keep cycles short and safe
  • During Santa Ana winds, indoor air quality can drop. Use your system fan on a low setting to mix air through a good media filter or a whole-home purifier
  • After a remodel or new paint, schedule a duct inspection to remove fine dust and odors that settled in the system
